nodes.summary: There is an integer $r \ge 3$ such that for infinitely many $k$ there are an $n$ and an $r$-uniform hypergraph $H$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with chromatic number $k$ (it is $k$-colorable but not $(k-1)$-colorable) that either has fewer than $\binom{(r-1)(k-1)+1}{r}$ edges, or has exactly that many edges but is not the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph on any set of $(r-1)(k-1)+1$ of its vertices.
nodes.title: Alon's refutation of Erdős Problem 832

nodes.summary: The statement that for every integer $r \ge 3$ there is a $K$ such that for every $k \ge K$, every $n$ and every $r$-uniform hypergraph $H$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ with chromatic number $k$ (it is $k$-colorable but not $(k-1)$-colorable), $H$ has at least $\binom{(r-1)(k-1)+1}{r}$ edges, and if it has exactly that many edges then it is the complete $r$-uniform hypergraph on some set of $(r-1)(k-1)+1$…
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 832

nodes.summary: A hypergraph $H$ on the vertex set $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, given as a finite set of edges (sets of vertices), is $k$-colorable when some coloring of the vertices with $k$ colors leaves no edge monochromatic: every edge of $H$ contains two vertices of different colors.
nodes.title: Colorable hypergraph

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
